changeSet.author: tchoi-rs
changeSet.comment: PRE-STACK SCHEMA CHANGE: Index ExtraField names, deletion flags and subtypes for discovery and hydration. On 100,000 instruments and 2,000,000 value rows, runtime-field discovery and hydration use the name prefix, deletion flag and subtype to avoid scanning ExtraField. The plain name predicate lets MariaDB use the prefix index beside the exact HEX identity.
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_extrafield_name_deleted ON ExtraField (name(128), deleted, DTYPE)

changeSet.author: tchoi-rs
changeSet.comment: PRE-STACK SCHEMA CHANGE: Index ExtraField owning instruments, names and deletion flags for correlated filters. On 100,000 instruments and 2,000,000 value rows, correlated runtime-field filters probe each owning instrument, then the name prefix and deletion flag. The plain name equality lets MariaDB use all three indexed columns.
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_extrafield_instr_name ON ExtraField (instrumentEntity_id, name(128), deleted)
